tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new KanbanThing board and return its id, shareable URL and password. No sign-up. Every board is password protected: pass `password` to choose one, otherwise a random password is generated and returned. Give both the URL and the password to whoever should use the board. Boards are deleted when they expire.

password.description: Board password. A random one is generated and returned if omitted.

columns.description: Columns left to right after Backlog. Defaults to To Do, In Progress, Done.

lifespan_days.description: Days until the board is deleted. Defaults to 60.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read a board by id: its name, expiry, columns and how many cards each column holds.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.

tools.name: list_columns
tools.description: List the columns on a board, left to right, with their ids.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List the cards on a board, optionally only those in one column.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.

column.description: Column name or id. Omit for every column.

limit.description: Maximum cards to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Add a card to a column on a board. Lands in Backlog when no column is given.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.

column.description: Column name or id. Defaults to Backlog.

tools.name: move_card
tools.description: Move a card to another column on the same board, at the end of that column.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.

tools.name: update_card
tools.description: Change a card title, description, due date or colour. Pass null to clear a field. Use move_card to change column.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.

due_date.description: Due day as YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

tools.name: delete_card
tools.description: Permanently delete a card from a board. This cannot be undone.

board_id.description: The board UUID, or the board URL the user shared. Never invent one.

password.description: The board password, if the board is protected.
